detail.longDescription: Unsloth Desktop Now Supports Using The AMD Ryzen AI NPU - Including On Linux: https://www. phoronix.com/news/Unsloth-Desk top-Ryzen-AI-NPU (Haven't heard of Unsloth before, but after trying it, it seems like the best AI tool I've seen so far. It requires zero setup, and it's basically a Swiss army knife, it does regular LLM chat with web search, image/video/music generation, deep research, agentic AI, and even some AI training utils. It immediately took the job of Moose, Vane and LocalAI lol. Wish I found it sooner, I didn't have to suffer that much with setting up everything.)
